welcome.text: Welcome to Ninja Maths. Tap the glowing mission to play.

choice.text: How many crystals can you see? Tap the number.

number.text: How many crystals can you see? Write the number, then tap the tick.

match.text: How many crystals can you see? Drag the number to the gate, or tap a number, then the gate.

try-again.text: Have another go. Tap the helping hand if you would like some help.

correct.text: Well done! A crystal is charged.

reward.text: Mission complete! Choose an upgrade. Tap a picture to see it on your ninja. Then tap the big tick to keep it.

practice.text: Well done! You have finished this practice mission.

chapter-complete.text: You did it! All ten missions are complete. You are a sunrise ninja! You can play any mission again.

equipment.text: These are your upgrades. Tap a picture to wear it. You can wear a sword, armour and a power together.

home.text: Tap a glowing mission number to play. A tick means you have finished it. A padlock means it is waiting for you.
